'''Maarten Logghe Rebel Scum Counter Deck''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Maarten Logghe]], published on [[Torch Industries]].<ref name="torch">[http://members.aol.com/drtorch/Rebel.html Maarten Logghe's Rebel Scum Counter Deck], Torch Industries (Paul Todd Feldman). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000305000736/http://members.aol.com:80/drtorch/Rebel.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Maarten Logghe]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Dagobah]] (from the card pool)
* '''Published:''' [[Torch Industries]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine: Jundland Wastes|Premiere-D-tatooinejundlandwastes.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Rebel Scum counter
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Logghe DS Rebel Scum Counter Torch.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==
Feldman published this deck by [[Maarten Logghe]], whom he called "Europe's #1 Ranked Player". The list has 61 cards as published.<ref name="torch" />
